svg.title: SoilMate | Nasa Petani system architecture
svg.desc: Current local CSV data flows through FastAPI into a browser dashboard with Folium maps and Plotly charts. A separate dashed lane shows planned NASA import, data preparation and forecasting. Open the accompanying HTML file for filters, click details, a request walkthrough and the full tool inventory.
svg.text: From environmental data to a clear view of rain, air, soil and plant conditions.
Dashed boxes and arrows = planned; no live NASA feed yet

g.aria-label: NASA data sources. Planned. Open details.
g.title: NASA data sources: Bring satellite and weather measurements into SoilMate. These product names appear in the supplied data, but the project does not yet download them.
g.text: Named in supplied data; download not built

g.title: Import measurements: Fetch selected products and keep the original downloads. The script is currently empty.
g.text: Keep raw files and source dates

g.aria-label: Prepare and check data. Planned. Open details.
g.title: Prepare and check data: Proposed step: clean dates, match locations, join measurements, and prepare the files used by the app.
g.text: Check units, gaps and risk rules

g.aria-label: Forecast future risk. Planned. Open details.
g.title: Forecast future risk: An optional future forecasting branch. It is separate from the current Simulation panel.
g.text: No forecast is used by the app

svg.text: Solid arrows = local data read and rendered into the browser

g.aria-label: Weather and risk files. Current. Open details.
g.title: Weather and risk files: Local CSV files supply the weather card, four risk cards and the soil scene.

g.aria-label: FastAPI and page rendering. Current. Open details.
g.title: FastAPI and page rendering: Receive browser requests, read matching data and render pages or HTML fragments using Jinja templates.
g.text: Serve pages, cards and soil scenes

g.title: Overview dashboard: Help a grower see the chosen state and date at a glance.

g.aria-label: Map data and boundaries. Current. Open details.
g.title: Map data and boundaries: Combine state-level risk categories with Malaysia state shapes.

g.aria-label: Build interactive maps. Current. Open details.
g.title: Build interactive maps: Folium builds a Leaflet map for the selected date and colours the state shapes using supplied categories.

g.aria-label: Five map layers. Current. Open details.
g.title: Five map layers: Explore Malaysia by switching between five state-coloured maps.
g.text: Pan, zoom and switch map layers
Leaflet map HTML inside an iframe

g.aria-label: Daily history files. Current. Open details.
g.title: Daily history files: Four CSVs hold summary rows and daily chart observations.

g.aria-label: Prepare chart data. Current. Open details.
g.title: Prepare chart data: Read the four history files, match the state and date, and build Plotly chart specifications.
g.text: Read daily series and build charts
Cache reads until a file changes

g.aria-label: Monitoring and Analysis. Current. Open details.
g.title: Monitoring and Analysis: Show trends and the underlying observations in simple charts.
